falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern-match similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 50% on the engine score within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom analog supporting an unresolved HOLD is broken, so UNKNOWN is no longer a justified stance on that pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70 on any daily reading in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The low-blowoff (38) read is wrong and the regime is a late-cycle blowoff, which invalidates HOLD/UNKNOWN in favor of a top-risk call

falsification_conditions.condition: The tracked broad risk index closes more than 5% above or below its bottom_2024_aug analog path for 5 consecutive sessions within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Price has left the analog range that justified indecision, forcing either a confirmed bottom breakout or a failed-bottom breakdown instead of HOLD

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
